title: The Sigil of Highmoor Anew
author: Casper Dravenmoor
blurb: Wren Okafor, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
